requirement_text: Implement RBAC Logic: Integrate RBAC logic into the authentication middleware to enforce access control based on user roles. Test RBAC functionality with different user roles and permissions scenarios to ensure that access control is enforced correctly. By assigning permissions to users based on their roles, we can ensure that they have appropriate access to resources and endpoints, improving the overall security and usability of the system.
